ICC CodeClash 2026

From DSA Fundamentals to Competitive Coding

ICC CodeClash 2026 is a two-stage online coding competition designed to evaluate participants on Data Structures and Algorithms, problem-solving, logical thinking, coding ability, algorithmic understanding, speed, and accuracy.

The competition follows a two-stage structure:

Round 1 → DSA MCQ Speed Round → Shortlisting → Final DSA Coding Round

Participants will first compete in an online MCQ-based DSA round. Based on their performance, including accuracy and completion speed, shortlisted participants will advance to the Final DSA Coding Round, which will be conducted on Hack The Future.

Official Communication

After registering for ICC CodeClash 2026 on Unstop, all participants are required to join the official WhatsApp group for important announcements, competition instructions, round details, updates, and further communication.

Official WhatsApp Group:
https://chat.whatsapp.com/CbZU0qrnx6s2u6I6Jc2E75

Participants are advised to regularly check the official WhatsApp group to stay updated with all competition-related information.

Competition Structure

Round 1 → Shortlisting → Final DSA Coding Round

The competition begins with the DSA MCQ Speed Round.

Participants will be evaluated based on their performance in Round 1. Selected participants will then be shortlisted for the Final DSA Coding Round.

Only shortlisted participants from Round 1 will be eligible to participate in the Final Round.

Round 1 – DSA MCQ Speed Round

Date: 22 October 2026
Mode: Online
Duration: 15 Minutes
Questions: 20 MCQ-based DSA Questions

Round 1 will consist of 20 multiple-choice questions covering basic-level Data Structures and Algorithms concepts.

The round is designed to assess:

  • DSA Fundamentals

  • Basic Data Structures and Algorithms

  • Problem-Solving Ability

  • Logical Thinking

  • Algorithmic Understanding

  • Speed and Accuracy

Speed and Accuracy

Participants will have 15 minutes to solve 20 questions. The shortlisting process will consider participants' performance in the round, with both accuracy and completion speed playing an important role.

Participants are therefore encouraged to maintain a balance between:

Accuracy + Speed + Effective Problem Solving

The Round 1 score and completion performance will be considered for shortlisting participants for the Final DSA Coding Round.

Final Round – DSA Coding Round

Date: 25 October 2026 (Sunday)
Mode: Online
Platform: Hack The Future

Participants shortlisted from Round 1 will compete in the Final DSA Coding Round.

The Final Round will consist of 5 DSA coding problems:

  • 3 Easy-Level DSA Coding Questions

  • 2 Medium-Level DSA Coding Questions

The Final Round will evaluate participants on:

  • Data Structures and Algorithms

  • Problem Solving

  • Algorithmic Thinking

  • Coding and Implementation

  • Logical Reasoning

  • Competitive Programming Skills

Participants will be required to solve the given problems within the specified competition duration.

Skills Assessed

ICC CodeClash 2026 will assess participants across the following areas:

  • Data Structures

  • Algorithms

  • DSA Fundamentals

  • Problem Solving

  • Logical Thinking

  • Algorithmic Thinking

  • Coding and Implementation

  • Competitive Programming

  • Speed and Accuracy

Important Dates

22 October 2026

Round 1 – DSA MCQ Speed Round

Online
20 Questions | 15 Minutes

After Round 1

Evaluation and Shortlisting

Participants will be evaluated based on their Round 1 performance, including speed and accuracy. Shortlisted participants will be invited to participate in the Final Round.

25 October 2026 (Sunday)

Prizes and Recognition

Winner

  • Winner Certificate

  • Unstop Merchandise

  • GFG Goodies

  • ICC LinkedIn Recognition

1st Runner-Up

  • 1st Runner-Up Certificate

  • Unstop Merchandise

  • GFG Goodies

  • ICC LinkedIn Recognition

2nd Runner-Up

  • 2nd Runner-Up Certificate

  • Unstop Merchandise

  • GFG Goodies

  • ICC LinkedIn Recognition

For All Participants

  • 1 Month Free ElevenLabs Plan

  • Participation Certificate

Detailed prize information will be provided separately in the Prize Section.

Important Instructions

  • Participation in Round 1 is mandatory for consideration for the Final Round.

  • Round 1 will consist of 20 basic-level DSA MCQs.

  • The total duration of Round 1 will be 15 minutes.

  • Participants should focus on both speed and accuracy.

  • Shortlisting for the Final Round will be based on Round 1 performance.

  • Only shortlisted participants will be eligible to participate in the Final DSA Coding Round.

  • The Final Round will be conducted online through Hack The Future.

  • The Final Round will consist of 3 Easy-Level and 2 Medium-Level DSA coding questions.

  • Participants must follow all rules, instructions, and timelines communicated by the organizers.

  • Participants should regularly check the official WhatsApp group for important announcements and updates.

Get Ready to Compete

ICC CodeClash 2026 provides participants with an opportunity to test their DSA fundamentals, problem-solving ability, coding skills, speed, and accuracy in a competitive environment.

Prepare your concepts, sharpen your problem-solving skills, and get ready to compete in the journey from DSA Fundamentals to Competitive Coding.

Code. Think. Solve. Compete.
